page_title: Claude Code by Anthropic | AI Coding Agent, Terminal, IDE

summary.name: Claude Code
summary.one_liner: Anthropic's agentic coding tool that reads a codebase, edits files, runs commands and tests, and opens pull requests from a terminal, IDE, Slack, or web interface.
use_cases: turning GitHub or GitLab issues into pull requests
summary.what_it_does: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that can take on tasks such as bug fixes, tests, and multi-day migrations. It builds a plan, asks clarifying questions, and works asynchronously on long-running jobs. It maps and explains large codebases using agentic search, without requiring manual context file selection. It follows imports across the repo, runs tests, and keeps going when something breaks. It works with GitHub, GitLab, and command line tools to read issues, write code, run tests, and open pull requests, and it asks for permission before changing files or running commands.
notable: Runs in the terminal and as native extensions for VS Code, Cursor, Devin Desktop, and JetBrains IDEs
Can use Git and MCP servers such as GitHub to extend its capabilities
Runs locally and talks directly to model APIs without a backend server or remote code index, per the page
Available on Team and Enterprise plans with pooled API credits and admin controls
caveats: Access requires a Claude Pro or Max plan, a Team or Enterprise plan, or a Claude Console account
With a Claude Console account, usage consumes API tokens at standard API pricing
Fast mode costs $8/$40 per million tokens and is in research preview
